iti82:2.1: tayome bhikkhave devesu devasaddā niccharanti samayā samayaṃ upādāya
iti82:2.3: yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye ariyasāvako kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāya ceteti tasmiṃ samaye devesu devasaddo niccharati
iti82:2.4: eso ariyasāvako mārena saddhiṃ saṅgāmāya cetetīti
iti82:2.5: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo devesu devasaddo niccharati samayā samayaṃ upādāya. 2
iti82:3.1: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave yasmiṃ samaye ariyasāvako sattannaṃ bodhipakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanānuyogamanuyutto viharati tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye devesu devasaddo niccharati
iti82:3.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo devesu devasaddo niccharati samayā samayaṃ upādāya. 3
iti82:4.1: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave yasmiṃ samaye ariyasāvako āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasam pajja viharati tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye devesu devasaddo niccharati
iti82:4.2: eso ariyasāvako vijitasaṅgāmo tameva saṅgāmasīsaṃ abhivijiya ajjhāvasatīti
iti82:4.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo devesu devasaddo niccharati samayā samayaṃ upādāya.
iti82:4.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo devesu devasaddā niccharanti samayā samayaṃ upādāyāti.
